# PhoenixTestPlaywright v0.15.0 - Table of Contents

> Execute PhoenixTest cases in an actual browser via Playwright.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [PhoenixTest.Playwright](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixTest.Playwright.md): Playwright driver for [PhoenixTest](https://hexdocs.pm/phoenix_test).
- [PhoenixTest.Playwright.Case](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixTest.Playwright.Case.md): ExUnit case module to assist with browser based tests.
`PhoenixTest.Playwright` and `PhoenixTest.Playwright.Config` explain
how to use and configure this module.
- [PhoenixTest.Playwright.Config](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixTest.Playwright.Config.md): Configuration options for the Playwright driver.
- [PhoenixTest.Playwright.JsLogger](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/PhoenixTest.Playwright.JsLogger.md): Default javascript logger.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix phoenix_test_playwright.test.websocket](https://phoenix-test-playwright.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.PhoenixTestPlaywright.Test.Websocket.md): Runs the test suite against a Playwright server running in a Docker container,
connected via websocket transport.
